best_idea: Run a fixed-step tick from an accumulator; when the server falls more than 5 ticks behind make one tick and forget the lost time (no burst), and repeat each player's last input for a tick whose input did not arrive, marked not received.
decision_why: Stall-skip and repeat-last-input fix the two tick problems under load (bursts and gaps) for a server-authoritative fight; the client lockstep, checksum and netticbuffer are rejected because only the server runs the fight and kills are server-verified.
acceptance: Server test: a 20-tick stall produces exactly one tick for that update and no catch-up burst; a player with no input for 3 ticks gets its last input repeated with received=false; a quitting player moves zero and keeps its aim.
